request.what: Reduce the committeeMinSize protocol parameter from 7 to 5.

claims.claim: The current Constitutional Committee has 7 members, equal to the current committeeMinSize setting of 7.

If Constitutional Committee membership drops below committeeMinSize, governance actions requiring Constitutional Committee approval become ineligible for ratification, including Parameter Changes, Constitution Updates, Treasury Withdrawals, and Hard Forks.
Reducing committeeMinSize to 5 would create an operational buffer so governance can continue if one or two members resign or their terms expire, assuming a current 7-member body.
The proposal depends temporally on enactment of another live Parameter Change action for Plutus cost model updates, but states there is no technical interaction between the two parameter changes.
The proposed change does not directly affect the current number of Constitutional Committee members and does not affect the maximum number of members.
With a Constitutional Committee size of 5 and a 2/3 threshold, 4 constitutional votes are needed to meet the threshold and 2 unconstitutional votes can prevent the threshold.
The proposal states that a 5-member committee makes it easier to reject governance actions because inactivity by one member would allow another member to fully veto governance actions.
The proposal states it underwent technical review through the Parameter Committee Parameter Change Process and links to the Cardano Forum PCP-005 discussion.
The proposal states that setting committeeMinSize to 5 satisfies guardrails requiring the value to be non-negative, not lower than 3, and not greater than 10.

The proposal says the change is reversible if at least 7 Constitutional Committee members exist, but reverting to 7 while fewer than 7 members are present would immediately halt governance until enough members are elected.

summary: The document proposes a non-treasury parameter change lowering committeeMinSize from 7 to 5 to reduce governance inoperability risk, while acknowledging reduced-member voting dynamics and providing references, guardrail discussion, and a conditional reversion plan.
